sections.heading: O događaju
paragraphs: Ljetna večer u Zmijavcima posvećena je žabama — iz kotlova na otvorenoj vatri, uz glazbu uživo i druženje do kasno u noć.
Uz bogatu ponudu domaćih specijaliteta, večer prate natjecanja uz kanal, uz bučno navijanje publike.

sections.heading: About the event
paragraphs: A summer evening in Zmijavci dedicated to frogs — cooked in cauldrons over an open fire, with live music and company late into the night.
Alongside a rich spread of local specialities, the evening features contests by the canal, cheered on by a lively crowd.
